title: Module 4: XLSForm development with your research questions

yaml.title: Module 4: XLSForm development with your research questions

markdown.markdown:
Now build your own form. Work from your approved thesis questionnaire.


1. **Copy** `msn_xlsform_template.xlsx` and rename it, e.g. `lastname_survey_v1.xlsx`. Keep the four metadata rows (`start`, `end`, `today`, `deviceid`) and replace the example rows with your own questions and answer options.
2. **Settings sheet:** write your form title (e.g. `Dinesh HTN Research`).
3. **Consent first:** add an introduction `note` and a required `select_one yes_no` consent question. Put the rest of the form in groups with `relevant` = `${consent} = 'yes'`.
4. **One group per section** of your questionnaire (Section A, B, C …).
5. **For each question**, decide the `type` (use the Module 1 summary table), give it a short `name`, and copy the English label.
6. **Add answer lists** in `choices`. Reuse lists (e.g. one `yes_no` list for all yes/no questions).
7. **Add rules:** `required`, `relevant` for skip patterns, `constraint` for ranges.
8. **Add Nepali labels** in `label::Nepali (ne)` if you will interview in Nepali.
9. **Save** and upload it in Module 6 to test.

## Naming conventions

| Good `name` | Bad `name` | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `age` | `Age of respondent` | No spaces |
| `q12_knowledge` | `12_knowledge` | Must start with a letter |
| `hb_level` | `hb-level` | Use `_`, not `-` |
| `anc_visits` | `x1` | Should be meaningful |

## Checklist before upload

- [ ] Sheet names are exactly `survey`, `choices`, `settings`
- [ ] Every `name` is unique with no spaces
- [ ] Every `select_one` / `select_multiple` list exists in `choices`
- [ ] Every `begin_group` has an `end_group`
- [ ] Text values in `relevant`/`constraint` are in single quotes
- [ ] Language column names are spelled identically everywhere
- [ ] `version` increased if you changed the form

::: {.callout-note}
## Assignment
Submit your XLSForm (`.xlsx`) covering **at least one full section** of your thesis questionnaire, including at least one skip rule, one constraint, and (if applicable) a Likert scale.
:::
